reviews.summary: Reviewer Shakeel Butt noted that the specified label value is incorrect and suggested using one of the supported values, specifically pointing to a previous patch that fixed an HID issue.
reviews.raw_body:
Seems like HID issue which is being fixed by http://lore.kernel.org/20260910153746.16222-1-ngocthang2710.1999@gmail.com

#syz set subsystems: hid

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the lock state in fs_reclaim_acquire is inconsistent, potentially leading to crashes or other problems. The problem arises from incorrect handling of cgroup locks, which can cause unexpected behavior when reclaiming memory. The patch corrects this by properly acquiring and releasing the necessary locks.
